   142→            context: Execution context with agent_results to synthesize

   144→        Returns:

   149→
   150→        self.logger.info(f"Synthesis agent executing: {task[:100]}...")
   151→
   152→        # Get agent results from context

   154→
   155→        if not agent_results:

   157→                "error": "No agent results to synthesize",
   158→                "agents_synthesized": 0
   159→            }
   160→
   161→        # Detect synthesis mode
   162→        mode = self._detect_mode(task, agent_results)
   163→
   164→        # Execute appropriate synthesis
   165→        if mode == SynthesisMode.COMBINE:
   166→            result = await self._combine(agent_results, context)
   167→        elif mode == SynthesisMode.RANK:
   168→            result = await self._rank(agent_results, context)
   169→        elif mode == SynthesisMode.RESOLVE:
   170→            result = await self._resolve(agent_results, context)
   171→        else:  # SUMMARIZE
   172→            result = await self._summarize(agent_results, context)
   173→
   174→        result.mode = mode
   175→        result.agents_synthesized = len(agent_results)
   176→        result.execution_time_ms = (time.time() - start_time) * 1000
   177→        result.checksum = self._compute_checksum(result)

   179→        self.logger.info(
   180→            f"Synthesis complete: {result.agents_synthesized} agents, "
   181→            f"coherence={result.coherence_score:.2f}"
   182→        )
   183→
   184→        return result.to_dict()
   185→
   186→    def _detect_mode(self, task: str, agent_results: Dict) -> SynthesisMode:
   187→        """Detect synthesis mode from task."""
   188→        task_lower = task.lower()
   189→
   190→        if any(kw in task_lower for kw in ["conflict", "resolve", "disagree", "differ"]):
   191→            return SynthesisMode.RESOLVE
   192→
   193→        if any(kw in task_lower for kw in ["rank", "priority", "best", "order", "top"]):

   195→
   196→        if any(kw in task_lower for kw in ["summary", "brief", "short", "condense"]):
   197→            return SynthesisMode.SUMMARIZE
   198→
   199→        # Default to combine
